test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The books should have been placed on their proper shelves.

options.text: You should place the books on their proper shelves.
You will have placed the books on their proper shelves.
You need to place the books on their proper shelves.
You should have placed the books on their proper shelves.

solution:
The correct answer is- 'You should have placed the books on their proper shelves.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect tense.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion to active voice is

 
 
• *subject + have/has + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *I have been pushed by him. *(passive)
 
• *He has pushed me. *(active)
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 4 *is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in present tense while converting from *active *to *passive *voice:

 
 
• Simple present - *subject + is/am/are + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football is played by him.*
 
 
 
• Present continuous - *subject + is/am/are + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car is being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Present perfect - *subject + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car has been driven by him.*
 
 
 
 

ad:T
